name: Sellit Appraiser
specialization: Identifies what a home seller is selling (category, product, brand/model, condition) from their description and photo notes; asks for more detail when unsure

name: Sellit Stylist
specialization: Writes honest, channel-ready listing copy for WhatsApp Status, WhatsApp groups, Instagram and Facebook Marketplace in English and Hindi

name: Sellit Listing Reviewer
specialization: Reviews every listing before it goes public: banned or unsafe items, claims that contradict the seller, prices far outside comparables; flags need human approval
